title: docs(changelog): stored sys_comment.reactions survive the v18 upgrade; amend the retirement entries in place
body:
Fixes #23938
Clause-②: no — release text moves no export, type or accept set.

## What this does

The published `18.0.0-next.0` entries of `@objectstack/plugin-audit` and `@objectstack/spec` say the emoji reactions stored in `sys_comment.reactions` are not converted and are gone after the upgrade. The shipped CLI does the opposite. This PR amends those entries **in place**, as AGENTS.md's Documentation Guardrails row for `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` prescribes ("amend that entry in a dedicated docs-only PR, never an erratum in a later entry"). It amends them in both CHANGELOGs and in the consumed `.changeset/pre/` notes they were rendered from, because `@changesets/read` 1.0.1 reads `.changeset/pre/*.md` back in at the GA version (`readChangesets`, `fs.readdir(path.join(changesetBase, "pre"))`), so the GA entry carries the corrected text.

Release text only: no code, no test, no new changeset, no other entry. Commit hashes (`29a163f`, `9963322`) and the rest of each entry are unchanged. The 23281 entry's supersession sentence stays as history, as the claim says.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION: please confirm in writing

This PR changes two changesets it did not add:

- `.changeset/pre/22573-sys-comment-reactions-retired.md`: the column-retirement note. What changed under it: `os migrate comment-reactions` (the 23281 changeset, shipped in `@objectstack/cli` `18.0.0-next.1`, `packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md:695`) now converts the stored reactions, and `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` refuses the drop until that conversion is verified.
- `.changeset/pre/22566-comment-reaction-record.md`: the note introducing `sys_comment_reaction`. Its last bullet carries the same "not converted" sentence (rendered at `plugin-audit/CHANGELOG.md:197` and `spec/CHANGELOG.md:3290`). The same change falsified it.

`Check Changeset` stays red **by design** on this PR. `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` exits 1 with "This PR changes a changeset it did not add", listing both notes. That is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class its two-class refusal names, and its remedy is "do NOT restore it -- say so on the PR and get it confirmed". Its route 0 in `pr-automation.yml` applies too: every changeset row is `M` and none is `A`, so the job's `Require a changeset` step also reds. `skip-changeset` is **not** applied, per ruling D on #18375: "the 'skip-changeset' label is never applied to a PR that edits an existing changeset". `Check Changeset` is not a required context. The ADR-0087 and major-bump steps still judge the two notes and pass locally (below).

## The premise, measured on `origin/main` (`6d1660dc3b`; unchanged at `68ffa5dc1a`)

- **The command converts the stored reactions.** `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/comment-reactions.ts:56-77`: "carry the emoji reactions a 17.x deployment stored in `sys_comment.reactions` into `sys_comment_reaction` records". `packages/cli/src/utils/comment-reactions-conversion.ts:30-46`: each distinct (comment, emoji, user) becomes one row, in the comment's organization, `created_by` = the reactor. A value that does not read is listed with its comment id and converts into nothing. Integration test `comment-reactions.integration.test.ts:291` ("--apply writes one record per stored reaction, lists what did not read, and invents nothing for it").
- **It is idempotent.** `comment-reactions-conversion.ts:49-55` ("A second run inserts nothing; an interrupted run is finished by running it again"). Test `:311` ("a re-run inserts nothing").
- **Dry run by default.** Test `:270` ("a dry run reports every stored reaction and writes nothing").
- **The drop waits for a verified conversion.** `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts:475-526`: when the intended changes drop `sys_comment.reactions`, the apply reads the `sys_migration` verdict (`readCommentReactionsConversion`, `comment-reactions-conversion.ts:463-474`, "Fails toward retention"). Unverified, it prints "Refusing to drop sys_comment.reactions: ... dropping the column would delete them" and exits 1 (`--json`: `refused_comment_reactions_unconverted`). Verified means no write failure, nothing left to convert and no unreadable value (`conversionVerified`, `:420-426`). Tests `:257` (refused before any conversion, column kept), `:319` (still refused while a value does not read), `:345` (after a verified run the drop proceeds and every reaction record survives it).
- **The spec's own prescription already says so.** `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.sys-comment-reactions-column-retired.ts:31-35` and `:52-58` ("The operator converts first, then drops").

## Every changed sentence, BEFORE and AFTER

Line numbers are at this PR's head. Each sentence is changed identically in every location listed for it.

**S1: the `sys_comment_reaction` introduction (`29a163f`), last bullet, last sentence.** `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/CHANGELOG.md:197` · `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:3290` · `.changeset/pre/22566-comment-reaction-record.md:17`

> BEFORE: It is retired separately, and reactions stored in it are not converted into records.
>
> AFTER: It is retired separately, and `os migrate comment-reactions` converts the reactions stored in it into records.

**S2: the retirement heading (`9963322`). Only its false last clause changed.** `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/CHANGELOG.md:198` · `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:3321` · `.changeset/pre/22573-sys-comment-reactions-retired.md:6`

> BEFORE: feat(plugin-audit)!: `sys_comment.reactions` retires; an emoji reaction lives only in `sys_comment_reaction`, and reactions stored in the old column are not migrated
>
> AFTER: feat(plugin-audit)!: `sys_comment.reactions` retires; an emoji reaction lives only in `sys_comment_reaction`, and reactions stored in the old column are converted into `sys_comment_reaction` records by `os migrate comment-reactions`

**S3: the bold lead paragraph's first two sentences. The paragraph's last two sentences are unchanged.** `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/CHANGELOG.md:206` · `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:3329` · `.changeset/pre/22573-sys-comment-reactions-retired.md:14`

> BEFORE: **Existing emoji reactions stored in `sys_comment.reactions` are gone after the upgrade.** They are not converted into `sys_comment_reaction` records, and no screen or API returns them again.
>
> AFTER: **Existing emoji reactions stored in `sys_comment.reactions` survive the upgrade.** They stay in the column, which no screen or API returns, until `os migrate comment-reactions` converts them into `sys_comment_reaction` records, and `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` drops the column only after that conversion is verified (see *Existing databases* below).

**S4: "Existing databases", last sentence. The paragraph's first three sentences are unchanged.** `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/CHANGELOG.md:222` · `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:3345` · `.changeset/pre/22573-sys-comment-reactions-retired.md:30`

> BEFORE: To drop it, run `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` with the audit plugin composed (an auth secret resolves); the stored reactions go with it.
>
> AFTER: Convert first, then drop. `os migrate comment-reactions` previews the conversion and writes nothing; `os migrate comment-reactions --apply` turns each stored (comment, emoji, user) into that user's own `sys_comment_reaction` record, in the comment's organization, lists every stored value it cannot read instead of guessing at it, and records the run verified once every stored value has read and converted. A re-run converts nothing twice. Only then does `os migrate apply --allow-destructive`, run with the audit plugin composed (an auth secret resolves), drop the column; before a verified run is recorded it refuses the drop and exits `1`, because the drop would delete the reactions.

## One file added to the claim's surface

The claim declares the CHANGELOG bullet at `:197` (S1). It does not declare that bullet's consumed source, `.changeset/pre/22566-comment-reaction-record.md`. Without it the GA re-render would repeat S1's false sentence, for the same reason the claim includes the 22573 note. It is added as a bounded in-place fix, and all four conditions hold:

1. Same defect class: the identical sentence.
2. Mechanical, with the form pinned by S1.
3. No other claim holds the file: none of the 14 open PRs' file lists, read through REST at this write, touches it or any other file here.
4. Same gate family: `check-empty-changeset` is already red by design on the 22573 note, so no new verification surface.

If the seat would rather not have it here, it is one file and one line.

## The second reading (22360 / 15204-7b positions): measured, not edited

Measured false of `main`, but not amended, because it is one member of a family rather than a one-entry error:

- **False of `main`.** `.changeset/pre/22360-declared-position-package-provenance.md` (`plugin-security/CHANGELOG.md:1114`, `18.0.0-next.0`) describes the `sys_position` admin data door answering `403` and a row-state patch passing. On `main` no `sys_position` row object exists: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/index.ts` exports `SysUserPermissionSet`, `SysUserPosition` and `SysAudienceBindingSuggestion` only, and nothing declares `name: 'sys_position'`. The stage-8 retirement (`66949b7`, `plugin-security/CHANGELOG.md:291`, `18.0.0-next.1`) says its data and REST routes are gone. `restampedPackageProvenance` and the `declared positions seeded` line have zero hits outside CHANGELOGs.
- **A family, not a one-off.** In `plugin-security/CHANGELOG.md`'s `18.0.0-next.0` section, 25 of 50 entries name a catalog row object (`sys_position`, `sys_permission_set`, `sys_capability`) that the next prerelease retires. They record intermediate ADR-0131 C3 stages. Amending 22360 alone would be a single-point fix of that family, and "keep the rest of its facts" has no reading for an entry whose heading and every section describe the retired row.
- **Why 22573 differs.** Its text is upgrade guidance that tells the reader their stored data is lost, and the shipped CLI contradicts it. 22360's entry is superseded by an explicit retirement entry in the same release line, and a write to the retired object answers loudly.

The PM report raises it as an open question.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- After this lands, `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:1493` (the 23281 entry, `6673c80`) still reads "This supersedes the 'stored reactions are not migrated' sentence in the entry that retired the column". The sentence it quotes no longer reads that way. The claim keeps it as history. Carrier: none.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment-retired-fields.test.ts:79` is a test docblock: "as amended: the column retires and its stored reactions are not migrated". It records the retirement ruling and is not published release text. No code or test is edited here. Carrier: none.

## Verification

Local, on head `cc5948e02a` (after the final merge of `origin/main` `68ffa5dc1a`):

- **Done-when grep.** `git grep -n "are not converted\|not migrated\|go with it\|are gone after the upgrade"` over both CHANGELOGs and both pre notes gives 10 hits. None states that the `sys_comment.reactions` data is lost. The one reactions hit is `spec/CHANGELOG.md:1493`, the history sentence above. The other nine are unrelated entries: `:296`, `:7098`, `:8367`, `:19912`, `:23369`, `:39804`, `:40618`, `:57912`, `:98229`.
- **`dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`** derived 68 commands. 64 exit 0. 1 is the designed red above (`check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, exit 1). 3 are NOT MEASURED, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET because only `@objectstack/spec` was built locally: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:lean-entry-closure`. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs them on a full build. `--ran` reconciliation: "68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED". `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` and `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` exit 0. `check:nul-bytes` exits 0.
- **Spec tests that read release text.** 32 `packages/spec` test files reference `CHANGELOG.md` or `.changeset`. Run with `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: "Test Files 32 passed (32) · Tests 489 passed (489)".
- **No package test or typecheck run.** No source, build input or test assertion reads the changed sentences. CHANGELOG.md is not a build input, and the diff moves no byte of any `dist/`.
